description: A shell script for testing and verifying the behavior of safe.bareRepository checks in a Git environment, including setup of repositories, configuration, and trace analysis.

methods.name: expect_accepted_implicit
methods.description: Checks if a bare repository is accepted implicitly by verifying trace output.

methods.name: expect_accepted_explicit
methods.description: Checks if a bare repository is accepted explicitly by verifying trace output.

methods.name: expect_rejected
methods.description: Checks if a bare repository is rejected by verifying trace output and error messages.
